summary: This short note covers the languages of Sierra Leone. It states that Sierra Leone is multilingual, that English is the de facto official language, and that Krio is the most widely spoken language, including in other countries. The note is brief and gives no further detail.
one_line: Overview of Sierra Leone's multilingual setting, noting English as de facto official language and Krio as the most widely spoken.
key_facts: Sierra Leone is a multilingual country.
English is the de facto official language of Sierra Leone.
Krio is the most widely spoken language in Sierra Leone.
Krio is spoken in different countries.
